agent-flow:fdu-experiment-to-device-task.description: Guides the Agent from a user experiment target through recommendation, amount calculation, plan generation, resource verification, protocol orchestration, confirmed device task creation, and optional read-only task monitoring.
agent-flow:fdu-experiment-to-device-task.name: FDU experiment target to device task

agent-flow:fdu-resource-snapshot.description: Read-only query of the workstation's current resources: refreshes the device resource snapshot and reports the resource list. Needs no step JSON; does not verify or backfill resources.
agent-flow:fdu-resource-snapshot.name: FDU resource snapshot query
